paper.title: High-fidelity neutral atom gates leveraging low-rank Hessian optimization

system.target_gate: CZ up to local Z and global phase
system.boundary: isolated factorized dimers; no inter-dimer interaction

hamiltonian.drive: one shared complex 302-nm actuator drives 1<->r and 0<->r_prime
hamiltonian.pair_model: effective rr, rr_prime/r_prime_r, and r_prime_r_prime R^-6 interactions
hamiltonian.pair_anchor: B0 calibrated to the paper-reported 1.6e-4 finite-blockade contribution; not MQDT
hamiltonian.effective_decay: 42 us lifetime; 90% to erasure and assumed equal split of the remaining 10% to 0/1

hardware.fit_target: digitized blue Before trace in paper Figure 4a
hardware.eom: not included because Liu et al. do not report an independent EOM in this gate path

feedback.controller_access: counts/fidelity estimate only; no state, exact channel, hidden context, gradient, or Hessian

runtime_contract.mwe: three 64-bin intensity points with coherent and exact open-system metrics
runtime_contract.acceleration: average a fixed hidden-context ensemble then draw finite shots; exact open-system anchors only at initial and final points
runtime_contract.reason: the platform's stochastic public runtime propagates once per shot and would exceed the one-hour budget

claim_boundary: The source-constrained AR waveform is an equivalent reoptimization because the authors did not publish the waveform array.
The effective R^-6 pair model is not the missing Liu MQDT table.
The AOM response is inferred from the rasterized paper trace, not a measured transfer-function file.
Laser spectra and microscopic decay branching remain calibrated priors with explicit provenance.
Simulator-generated finite-shot observations are digital-twin data, not laboratory measurements.
